name: Kids TV flat bright
summary: Simple, readable children's TV anime: rounded clean characters, flat bright primary colour with one shadow tone, uncluttered sunny backgrounds.

traits.line: Clean, even, medium-thick rounded lines; minimal detail; thinner softer lines in later seasons.
traits.shading: Flat fills with a single hard shadow tone; small glossy highlights.
traits.palette: Bright saturated primaries - red, yellow, blue, green - with sky-blue skies and grass green; high key.
traits.lighting: Bright even daylight; colourful energy-attack glows.
traits.faces: Round faces, big simple eyes, readable expressions; round mascot creatures.
traits.backgrounds: Simple painted fields, forests and small towns with clean shapes and soft-gradient skies.
traits.texture: Clean; early seasons painted cels with film grain (a noise filter was added after the 2002 digital switch).

style_words: Children's TV anime: clean even medium-thick rounded lines, flat bright saturated red, yellow, blue and grass-green fills with a single hard shadow tone, small glossy highlights, high-key even daylight, simple uncluttered painted fields and sky-blue skies with soft gradients, clean finish, as in the Pokemon anime (1997).
